scripts.dev: tsx scripts/database.ts --db=.pglite --port=5497 --run "pnpm run setup && pnpm run dev:apps"
scripts.dev:apps: concurrently -n group,uk,norway -c green,cyan,magenta "pnpm --filter @kizunajs-demo/sites-group run dev" "pnpm --filter @kizunajs-demo/sites-countries run dev:uk" "pnpm --filter @kizunajs-demo/sites-countries run dev:norway"
scripts.dev:partner: pnpm run partner:install && cd partner && pnpm dev
scripts.partner:install: pnpm --filter @hagen/uk-content build && pnpm --filter @hagen/uk-content pack --out "$PWD/partner/vendor/hagen-uk-content.tgz" && pnpm --filter kizunajs pack --out "$PWD/partner/vendor/kizunajs.tgz" && cd partner && pnpm install --offline
scripts.e2e:server: rm -rf .pglite-e2e && tsx scripts/database.ts --db=.pglite-e2e --port=5496 --run "pnpm run setup && pnpm run dev:apps"
scripts.e2e:partner:hagen: rm -rf .pglite-partner-e2e && tsx scripts/database.ts --db=.pglite-partner-e2e --port=5495 --run "pnpm run setup && pnpm --filter @kizunajs-demo/sites-countries run dev:uk"
